sourceSystem.description: Indicates the source system from which this canonical is imported

timestamp.description: Indicates the timestamp of the canonical in source system

sourcesId.description: Id of the {@link Sources} for the Source

start.description: The start timestamp when the measurement period begins.

end.description: The end timestamp when the measurement period ends. This can be null for ongoing measurements.

value.description: The measured value during the specified time period.

dataVersion.description: The version of the data used for this measurement. Can be used for version control.

isEstimate.description: Indicates whether the measurement value is an estimate (true) or an actual reading (false).

servicePointId.description: The service point identifier associated with this measurement.

assetId.description: The asset identifier that the measurement corresponds to.

statusCode.description: The status code of the measurement.

channel.description: The channel through which the measurement was taken.

title:
Represents a unique kind of measurement – for example, power (kW), energy (kWh), voltage, or temperature.
A MeterReading contains measurement values and timestamps, typically used to track resource usage,
sensor readings, or asset conditions over time.
name: CanonicalMeasurement
